title: Preparation of a Z-scheme BiVO4/Cu2O/PPy heterojunction and studying its CO2 reducing properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13313-13322
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08130G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hengxin Ren, Xinyu Sun, Tong Li, Zhixin Ren, Chaoyu Song, Yuguang Lv, Ying Wang
Herein, a new Z-scheme BiVO4/Cu2O/PPy heterostructure photocatalyst was developed with bismuth nitrate and ammonium vanadate as the precursors and sodium dodecyl benzyl sulfonate as the soft template.
